brassHellBeginnerGuide.title: BRASS HELL Beginner Guide
brassHellBeginnerGuide.intro: BRASS HELL is built around a repeatable factory workflow. Clock in, operate the ammunition press, craft your first rounds, fill shipment crates, and deliver completed orders - then reinvest every payout into workshop upgrades that make the next cycle faster.

steps.title: Clock In at the Factory
steps.description: Enter the remote ammunition factory and clock in before starting production. Use your first minutes on site to find the press, crafting stations, crate area, and shipment route.

steps.title: Operate the Press
steps.description: Use the press to start manufacturing ammunition. Follow the station prompts and repeat the production action until you have enough rounds for your first shipment.

steps.title: Craft Ammunition Rounds
steps.description: Convert factory materials into finished rounds. Keep the production area clear and keep crafting until a full crate quantity is ready.

steps.title: Fill the Shipment Crates
steps.description: Carry finished rounds to the crate area and pack them into the right shipment containers. Check crate progress before leaving the production floor.

steps.title: Deliver the Shipment
steps.description: Move the filled crate to the delivery point and complete the handoff. Your first delivery establishes the main earnings loop that funds every future upgrade.

steps.title: Reinvest in Workshop Upgrades
steps.description: Put early payouts back into the workshop instead of stopping after one delivery. Prioritize upgrades that shorten the cycle or raise the value of future shipments.

quickTips: Learn the full loop first: press, rounds, crate, delivery - it pays every single time.
Watch crate progress before leaving the production floor to avoid half-finished trips.
Early upgrades that speed up the press pay for themselves within a few shipments.
With up to four players per server, splitting jobs keeps the whole factory line moving.

brassHellCraftingShipment.title: BRASS HELL Crafting & Shipment Guide
brassHellCraftingShipment.intro: A full production cycle runs from collecting materials through the ammunition press to packing and dispatching the finished crate. Efficient shifts prepare the next order materials before the current one ships, so the factory never sits idle.

steps.title: Collect and Organize Materials
steps.description: Gather the materials required by the active order and keep them near the production area. Check order requirements before starting so missing components never interrupt the press.
steps.tip: Prepare materials for the next order while the current shipment is being packed.

steps.title: Operate the Ammunition Press
steps.description: Load the required materials, run the production interaction, and collect finished ammunition batch by batch. Keep the machine active whenever materials are available.
steps.tip: Return to the press immediately after collecting a finished batch.

steps.title: Restock the Production Line
steps.description: Replace materials consumed by the last batch before they stop the next cycle. Restocking is part of the regular factory loop, not a one-time chore.
steps.tip: Use a repeatable route between the material supply and the press to cut walking time.

steps.title: Complete the Shipment Order
steps.description: Compare finished products with the active order, move everything to the packing area, and confirm every requested item is included before you leave the line.
steps.tip: Finish the full batch before one delivery trip so a single journey closes the order.

steps.title: Pack the Crate and Dispatch
steps.description: Load completed products into the shipment crate, finalize the package, and send it through dispatch - then immediately review the next order.
steps.tip: Treat dispatch as the end of one cycle and the start of the next.

systems.how: Keep completing production work and other activities that award Mastery XP
systems.pass: The Mastery XP pass is the progression option tied to Mastery XP gains

systems.name: Rank Progress
systems.purpose: Tracks advancement through the game's rank ladder while you complete factory work
systems.how: Earn Rank Progress through eligible production and shipment activities
systems.pass: The Rank Progress pass is the progression option tied to rank advancement

systems.name: Bulk Multipliers
systems.purpose: Supports larger, more efficient production output through the Bulk benefit
systems.how: Run bulk-oriented production when the factory supports it and complete the corresponding work
systems.pass: The Bulk pass focuses on bulk production rather than replacing Rank or Mastery gains

systems.name: Regular Factory Work
systems.purpose: The core loop that produces ammunition, completes orders, and sends shipments
systems.how: Operate the press, restock materials, finish orders, pack crates, and dispatch shipments
systems.pass: Passes supplement the loop - production and shipment work still drives all progression

faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.subtitle: Everything players ask about BRASS HELL, answered

questions.question: What is BRASS HELL?
questions.answer: BRASS HELL is a Roblox incremental factory simulator set in a remote, snowbound ammunition plant. You clock in, operate the press, craft rounds, pack crates, and deliver shipments while upgrading the workshop and uncovering hidden documents.

questions.question: Is BRASS HELL free to play?
questions.answer: Yes. BRASS HELL is free to play on Roblox, with optional game passes such as Mastery XP, Rank Progress, and Bulk multipliers for players who want faster progression.

questions.question: How many players can play BRASS HELL together?
questions.answer: BRASS HELL servers hold up to four players, so you can run the factory line with friends or solo.

questions.question: Does BRASS HELL have codes?
questions.answer: BRASS HELL has not added a code redemption system yet. When the developer releases codes, our BRASS HELL Codes page lists every active and expired code in one place.

questions.question: How do you make money in BRASS HELL?
questions.answer: Money comes from the shipment loop: craft rounds on the ammunition press, pack them into crates, and dispatch completed orders. Workshop upgrades raise production speed and shipment value.

questions.question: What are hidden documents in BRASS HELL?
questions.answer: Hidden documents are collectible files scattered around the factory. Finding them reveals fragments of the story behind the plant - check offices, storage rooms, production areas, and hidden routes.
